scripts.cf:build: bun run build && node node_modules/cf/bin/cf build
scripts.cf:check: bun run cf:build && node node_modules/cf/bin/cf deploy --prebuilt --worker cc-site-preview --dry-run
scripts.cf:build:production: bun run build && node node_modules/cf/bin/cf build --mode production
scripts.cf:check:production: bun run cf:build:production && node node_modules/cf/bin/cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production --worker cc-site --dry-run
scripts.cf:dev: bun run build && node node_modules/cf/bin/cf dev
